en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara Bin Ayn who said,

‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about the pregnant slave girl whom the man buys, so he attains from her besides the private part. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’. I said, ‘Supposing he attains from her in that?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do you intend deception?’
